n685c90cc04.headline: Epoch Biodesign secures $12m to expand nylon 6,6 recycling
n685c90cc04.summary: UK-based Epoch Biodesign secured $12 million in new investment from lululemon, KOMPAS VC, Extantia and others. The funding will accelerate commercialisation of its recycled nylon 6,6 technology.
n685c90cc04.why: Epoch Biodesign is a materials technology company, and its funding shows investor interest in recycled synthetic fibres for apparel supply chains.

n9e1d71fef5.headline: Ukraine hits oil facilities, keeping pressure on Russia
n9e1d71fef5.summary: Ukraine has hit oil facilities, keeping pressure on Russia after heavy Russian drone and missile strikes on Ukrainian cities. President Zelenskiy said pressure on Moscow needs to be maintained.
n9e1d71fef5.why: Attacks on oil refining and export infrastructure can reduce available supply and affect global crude and refined product prices.

n7ebdf2f96a.headline: 5 Biggest Gainers in the S&P/ASX 200 Today: DroneShield Soars 19% to Lead ASX 200 Gainers
n7ebdf2f96a.summary: DroneShield surged 19.33 percent to A$4.26, leading ASX 200 gainers as investors favoured counter-drone and resources names amid the US-Iran conflict.
n7ebdf2f96a.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's main benchmark index, and DroneShield is a defence technology company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

n26a872dfee.headline: Concord New Energy reports 82.6% decline in FY2025 earnings to 139.7 million yuan
n26a872dfee.summary: Concord New Energy reported a 82.6 percent decline in FY2025 earnings to 139.7 million yuan, its first results since its secondary Singapore listing on January 6.
n26a872dfee.why: Concord New Energy is a Chinese clean-energy company that has a secondary listing on the Singapore Exchange, so its results matter to investors in both markets.

ne6e5db5d68.headline: Euro zone consumers turn gloomier amid Iran war fears
ne6e5db5d68.summary: Consumers in the euro zone's three largest economies grew more pessimistic as war in the Middle East raises fuel costs and threatens a new wave of inflation.
ne6e5db5d68.why: Consumer sentiment shapes household spending, which drives growth and affects the European Central Bank's inflation outlook.

n35c3af64e0.headline: Greece plans further minimum wage rise amid Iran war pressure
n35c3af64e0.summary: Greece will raise its gross monthly minimum wage by 4.5% to 920 euros from April 1, the sixth rise in four years. The move aims to offset rising energy costs, with a target of 950 euros by 2027.
n35c3af64e0.why: Minimum wage policy affects labour costs for employers, consumer spending and the government's inflation and social policy outlook.

nfd53b187e0.headline: Some Czech energy suppliers raise gas prices as market reacts to Middle East crisis
nfd53b187e0.summary: Some Czech energy suppliers have raised gas prices. The moves follow market reaction to the Middle East crisis.
nfd53b187e0.why: Gas prices feed into household and industrial energy costs and inflation. Supplier pricing responds to wholesale gas markets, which are sensitive to Middle East supply risks.

n521e28c195.headline: Brazil Passes Law Allowing Seized Crypto to be Used for Public Security
n521e28c195.summary: Brazil has passed a law that lets seized crypto be used for public security. It includes provisions on freezing crypto on exchanges and seizing assets to fight organised crime.
n521e28c195.why: Brazil is Latin America's largest economy and a major crypto market. Rules on freezing and seizing digital assets affect exchanges and holders of crypto in the country.

n1b23ff06fc.headline: Trump grants Iran another extension on a deadline to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
n1b23ff06fc.summary: Trump said he will hold off on striking Iran's power plants until April 6. The delay postpones a deadline for Iran to let ships transit the Strait of Hormuz safely.
n1b23ff06fc.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil. Disruption there moves crude prices and shipping costs.
n1b23ff06fc.why_moved: A postponed deadline for reopening the Strait of Hormuz extends uncertainty over shipping through a key oil route. Markets are weighing the risk of delayed escalation.

n499c6f4f12.headline: Global group backs cuts, rate rises to curb inflation
n499c6f4f12.summary: Australia's inflation rate is expected to peak higher than previously forecast as surging oil costs push up consumer prices. The forecast comes from a global group backing rate rises.
n499c6f4f12.why: Inflation peaks shape central-bank rate decisions, which affect bond yields and the Australian dollar. The ASX 200 is the main benchmark for Australian equities.

n284e2cdc8e.headline: Iran and the US harden their positions over talks to end the nearly month-old war
n284e2cdc8e.summary: Iran and the United States appear at an impasse, with each side hardening its position over talks. The standoff sets the stage for another potential escalation in the Middle East war.
n284e2cdc8e.why: Iran and the US are central players in Middle East energy supply and security. Diplomatic breakdowns tend to raise oil prices and risk premiums across global markets.

nb9829ee9b4.headline: Hallenstein Glassons profit jumps 32% as sales surge to $275m
nb9829ee9b4.summary: Hallenstein Glassons reported a 32% profit increase with sales of $275 million. Glassons Australia contributed $151.8 million in sales and $13.8 million in net profit.
nb9829ee9b4.why: Hallenstein Glasson Holdings is a New Zealand-listed apparel retailer whose results indicate consumer retail demand in the region.

n4e21e69f6f.headline: Bigger fines for dodgy servos but fuel fears remain
n4e21e69f6f.summary: Bigger fines are proposed for dodgy service stations, but fuel price fears remain. Fresh produce is likely to rise in price as higher fuel costs flow through supply chains.
n4e21e69f6f.why: Fuel retail pricing affects transport costs across the economy, and regulatory scrutiny of petrol retailers affects listed fuel companies.

n711c3a4f0d.headline: Iran war erases global growth upgrade, fans inflation: OECD
n711c3a4f0d.summary: The OECD projects global GDP growth at 2.9% in 2026, edging up to 3% in 2027. The Iran war has erased an earlier growth upgrade and is fanning inflation.
n711c3a4f0d.why: The OECD is the Paris-based group of advanced economies that publishes widely watched global growth forecasts. Its outlook shapes expectations for central-bank policy and corporate earnings.

n71fcfd4968.headline: Pakistan stresses coordinated economic, energy response amid regional tensions
n71fcfd4968.summary: A meeting chaired by Zardari reviewed oil supply risks and the security outlook. Islamabad is relaying US-Iran messages.
n71fcfd4968.why: Pakistan imports much of its oil, so supply disruptions in the Gulf directly affect its fuel costs and external finances. Energy security is a key concern for its economy.

n92b21fa297.headline: Consumer confidence deteriorates as Middle East conflict rages on
n92b21fa297.summary: The ANZ-Roy Morgan Consumer Confidence index dropped to a 17-month low as the Middle East conflict continues. Consumer sentiment is deteriorating.
n92b21fa297.why: Consumer confidence signals household spending intentions, which drive a large share of economic activity. The ANZ-Roy Morgan index is a closely watched gauge in Australia.

n3edfb0b411.headline: Natural Gas Holds Below $3 as LNG Constraints Tighten Supply
n3edfb0b411.summary: US natural gas futures held below $3 per unit as constraints on liquefied natural gas (LNG) supply tightened. The market analysis cites LNG constraints as the main supply pressure.
n3edfb0b411.why: Natural gas prices feed into power generation, heating and industrial costs, and LNG flows connect regional gas markets worldwide.

impacts.name: Natural gas futures
impacts.why: The article reports natural gas futures holding below $3 as LNG supply tightens.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nd8a6df420c.headline: Singapore’s general insurance premiums hit record high of S$6.09 billion
nd8a6df420c.summary: General insurance premiums in Singapore reached a record S$6.09 billion. Net incurred claims in the domestic segment rose 8.7% year on year to S$1.8 billion.
nd8a6df420c.why: General insurers underwrite property, motor and health risks, and their premium and claims trends signal demand and pricing in the sector.

n44094a1680.headline: Sunway shareholders grant 99.97% approval for IJM takeover as deadline nears
n44094a1680.summary: Sunway shareholders granted 99.97% approval for the IJM takeover as the deadline nears. The focus now shifts to decisions by remaining government-linked funds.
n44094a1680.why: IJM Corporation is a Malaysian construction and property group, and Sunway is a Malaysian conglomerate. Large takeovers in Malaysia often hinge on institutional and state-linked shareholder decisions.

n3d57ca26e6.headline: PSX sheds over 5,000 points as profit-taking grips market
n3d57ca26e6.summary: The KSE-100 index slipped to near 153,300 as profit-taking and broad-based selling pressure gripped the Pakistan Stock Exchange. The index shed more than 5,000 points.
n3d57ca26e6.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking the country's largest listed companies. Its moves reflect local investor sentiment and macroeconomic conditions.
n3d57ca26e6.why_moved: Profit-taking and broad-based selling pressure drove the index down, according to the report.

nda345d3378.headline: Muscat Stock Exchange hits highest level since 2008, crosses 8,000 mark
nda345d3378.summary: The Muscat Stock Exchange reached its highest level since 2008 and crossed the 8,000 mark. Market participants attributed the rally partly to strong corporate earnings of listed firms.
nda345d3378.why: The Muscat Stock Exchange is Oman's main securities market, and its index reflects the performance of major Omani listed companies. Oil-linked economies like Oman are sensitive to energy prices.
nda345d3378.why_moved: Market participants believe the rally has been supported by strong corporate earnings from firms listed on the exchange.

n5b60549a8d.headline: Emaar shareholders approve $2.4bln dividend payout
n5b60549a8d.summary: Emaar shareholders approved a $2.4 billion dividend payout. The developer reported total 2025 revenues of $13.51 billion.
n5b60549a8d.why: Emaar Properties is one of the largest property developers in the Middle East, with major listings in Dubai. Dividend approvals signal cash returns to shareholders.

nab1099afa6.headline: South Korea to carry out bond buyback, expand fuel tax breaks to cushion blow from Iran conflict
nab1099afa6.summary: South Korea will conduct a bond buyback in two tranches of 2.5 trillion won each, on March 27 and April 1. The government is also expanding fuel tax breaks to cushion the impact of the Iran conflict.
nab1099afa6.why: Bond buybacks are a tool government and central banks use to manage yields and market liquidity. Fuel tax relief shapes domestic energy costs and inflation.

n1a77988011.headline: US/Israel-Iran War: UN chief appoints Special Envoy for peace
n1a77988011.summary: The UN secretary-general appointed a special envoy for peace in the US/Israel-Iran war. He said diplomacy must prevail and that a way out of the disaster is needed.
n1a77988011.why: Diplomatic efforts to end the conflict affect energy markets, shipping routes and regional stability that investors monitor.

n36609717a9.headline: Southeast Asia is being hit hard by Iran's cutoff of oil and gas
n36609717a9.summary: Southeast Asia is among the regions hardest hit by Iran's cutoff of oil and gas through the Strait of Hormuz, with many nations almost entirely dependent on foreign energy.
n36609717a9.why: Southeast Asian economies rely heavily on imported Gulf oil and gas, so supply cuts quickly affect their fuel, power and industrial sectors.

n1029aec27e.headline: Russian oil arrives as Philippines battles ‘energy emergency’
n1029aec27e.summary: President Ferdinand Marcos said the Philippines is casting a wide net for fuel, with dwindling stocks expected to last only another 45 days. Russian oil has arrived.
n1029aec27e.why: The Philippines imports most of its fuel, so supply shortfalls hit its economy, inflation and transport costs directly.

n612143c814.headline: FBM KLCI remains steady amid choppy trading
n612143c814.summary: The FBM KLCI remained flat at midday as trading was choppy and investors stayed cautious amid mixed domestic and global news.
n612143c814.why: The FBM KLCI is Malaysia's benchmark index of the largest companies listed on Bursa Malaysia, so it reflects the country's overall equity sentiment.

impacts.name: FBM KLCI
impacts.why: The index was flat at midday amid choppy trading.

n50f7aae34b.headline: Asian stocks fall and oil prices rise again as Middle East war continues
n50f7aae34b.summary: Asian stocks fell and oil prices rose again as the Middle East war continued. The Strait of Hormuz, through which about a fifth of world crude typically passes, remains shut.
n50f7aae34b.why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil shipping routes. Disruptions there feed directly into crude prices and regional equity markets.
n50f7aae34b.why_moved: The Strait of Hormuz remains shut, cutting flows of roughly a fifth of world crude, which pushed oil prices higher and weighed on Asian stocks.

nf476411db4.headline: PSX slips as doubts grow over Middle East peace
nf476411db4.summary: The KSE-100 index settled at 152,207.89, up 1,225.99 points, after an intraday high of 157,442.68. Stocks slipped on Thursday as doubts over Middle East peace grew.
nf476411db4.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking its largest listed companies. Its moves reflect local and global risk sentiment.
nf476411db4.why_moved: Doubts over Middle East peace weighed on investor sentiment, reversing much of the index's earlier intraday gain.

na375400bef.headline: Indonesia ramps up food reserves ahead of ‘Godzilla’ El Nino
na375400bef.summary: Indonesia has put measures in place to safeguard food supply and stabilise prices. Authorities are preparing for a prolonged drought expected in April as El Nino risks rise.
na375400bef.why: Indonesia is a large importer and producer of staple foods such as rice, so drought risk can push up domestic food prices. Government stock operations influence inflation and farm incomes.

ne92a6240f5.headline: Dollar sluggish with market on edge, Fed hike bets trimmed
ne92a6240f5.summary: The dollar eased from recent gains in Asian trading as investors sought clarity on whether de-escalation in the US-Israeli war on Iran was imminent. Bets on Fed rate hikes were trimmed.
ne92a6240f5.why: The US dollar is the world's main reserve currency, and expectations for Federal Reserve policy shape global currency, bond and equity markets.
ne92a6240f5.why_moved: Investors weighed whether a de-escalation in the Iran war was imminent, and trimmed bets on Fed rate hikes, which weighed on the dollar.

n5ec8c0f787.headline: BOJ set to release indicators for estimated core CPI every month now
n5ec8c0f787.summary: The Bank of Japan will release indicators for estimated core consumer prices every month. The move responds to recent scrutiny of the central bank's policy path.
n5ec8c0f787.why: The Bank of Japan sets monetary policy for Japan, and its inflation data guides expectations for interest rates and the yen.

n7e5f4c36b0.headline: Country has sufficient petroleum products for April and beyond, monitoring committee says amid global crisis
n7e5f4c36b0.summary: Pakistan's monitoring committee says the country has sufficient petroleum products for April and beyond. Finance Minister Dar directed authorities to ensure uninterrupted supply.
n7e5f4c36b0.why: Fuel supply security affects inflation, transport costs and the government's fiscal position in import-dependent economies like Pakistan.

nbe81bf5b7c.headline: SBP's foreign reserves increase by $22 million to $16.37 billion
nbe81bf5b7c.summary: State Bank of Pakistan foreign reserves increased by $22 million to $16,375.8 million in the week ending March 19, 2026.
nbe81bf5b7c.why: Foreign exchange reserves held by the central bank indicate a country's capacity to cover imports and external debt and support its currency.

n98355dce72.headline: SBP Reserves Gain $22 Million to Jump Near $17 Billion
n98355dce72.summary: Foreign reserves held by the State Bank of Pakistan rose by $22 million in the week ended March 19, 2026. Reserves are near $17 billion.
n98355dce72.why: Foreign exchange reserves indicate a country's capacity to pay for imports and service external debt, which affects its currency and sovereign risk.

nf0f3a22c1b.headline: US-Israel-Iran War: Fuel Prices on the Rise
nf0f3a22c1b.summary: The US-Israel-Iran conflict is pushing fuel prices higher, challenging government promises to maintain stability. The report examines implications for consumers and the economy.
nf0f3a22c1b.why: Fuel prices feed into transport costs and inflation, so rising oil costs strain household budgets and government fiscal plans in import-dependent economies.

n90d72825dd.headline: NFC Award Battles Amid Iran Crisis Impact
n90d72825dd.summary: The National Finance Commission faces delays in finalising the NFC Award due to geopolitical tensions. The delay affects funding distributions among provinces.
n90d72825dd.why: The NFC Award sets how federal revenue is divided among Pakistan's provinces, shaping public spending and fiscal policy.

n11e07d5f16.headline: Rising fuel costs: Government weighs in on 'working from home' option
n11e07d5f16.summary: In response to rising fuel prices, the South African government is evaluating policies that could make working from home mandatory to reduce commuting costs.
n11e07d5f16.why: Government policies on work arrangements can influence labor markets, consumer spending, and corporate operations, affecting economic activity.

n0e58c4f919.headline: Leitrim Macra says fuel supports fall short for rural Ireland
n0e58c4f919.summary: Rising diesel prices in rural Ireland are increasing costs for farmers during the silage season, according to local reports.
n0e58c4f919.why: Fuel costs impact agricultural production expenses, influencing rural economies and food supply chains.
